name: Ferulorum
storyline: Five generations ago in the land of Novilux tragedy struck the king and a curse seemed to fall upon the land, all seemed lost until. An heir to the throne stepped forward beset on all sides by enemies, to rebuild what was lost he needs an ancient family heirloom. The Clatiulus crystal, without the resources to spare a royal proclamation was sent throughout the land offering great rewards to any who reclaim the crystal. This is your chance, you are not a solder, or warrior, or even a thief... but instead a humble merchant and by your estimation you've got just enough gold to set up a small encampment within striking distance of the last known location of the Clatiulus. All that's missing are some friends skilled in the ways of war who are willing to split the profits, and individuals like that are all heading to the same destination...
summary: Strategy/simulation game/Auto-Battler - Higher mercenaries, equip them, organize them into a team and watch as they fight through the dungeon collecting loot and gold. Clear your way through 5 locations in the Kingdome so you can enter the deepest reaches of the castle and reclaim the lost relic.
